question: Notion task 区间1.618测试 stage2: after a first weekly 1618 touch, does the reaction in the next 1h/2h/4h tell whether the level will hold?
selection: One of 12 cells (3 checkpoints x unresolved/inside/inside_clean/inside_shallow) chosen on the earlier period (before 2026-01-01) by excess mean R over matched random with n>=200; later period judges only that cell.
success_criterion: Later period selected cell: mean R >0 AND excess R over matched random >0 AND week-cluster sign-flip p<0.01.
exit: Entry at checkpoint close; SL 2.0 extension, TP Monday near edge, fixed prices; later bars only, ties stop-first, 14-day horizon mark; fee 0.
null: 3 random bar closes per entry, same symbol/NY week/side, identical price distances to stop and target, same ordering rules.
limitations: 15m OHLC, conservative ties, independent R not account returns, no fees/funding/slippage.
